name: – Konstantinos Arvanitis – § 102
title: REPORT on the Commission’s 2025 Rule of Law report
part_text: Stresses that the absence of accessible legal gender recognition procedures constitutes a violation of fundamental rights; calls on all Member States to guarantee legal recognition of gender identity based on self-determination, ensure mutual recognition across borders and protect personal data, in line with the case-law of the European Court of Human Rights;
